subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the existing `google-vertex` provider while keeping the provider id stable?
rationale: The code change is small, but choosing between the reporter's wording, Google's bridge wording, and the current established OpenClaw copy is a product/copy decision.

options.title: Use Google's bridge wording
options.body: Update user-facing copy to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` or a maintainer-approved variant while preserving `google-vertex` as the id.

options.title: Use the reporter's shorter wording
options.body: Use `Google Enterprise AI` in UI copy even though current Google Cloud pages use the longer Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform name.

options.title: Keep current wording for now
options.body: Leave `Google Vertex AI` until maintainers choose a broader Google provider naming pass.

recommendation.title: Use Google's bridge wording
recommendation.body: Update user-facing copy to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)` or a maintainer-approved variant while preserving `google-vertex` as the id.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest adjacent provider-catalog ownership signal and were already asked for the decision in the issue thread.
